answer: Pay forecasters for added information, not headcount. On a hidden holdout set, compare an ensemble's prediction error with and without each submission; only a reduction in error earns reward, under a fixed total budget. Identical forecasts are deduplicated before scoring. An oasis of cedar forecasts gains nothing from a canyon of copied accounts: a farm must supply genuinely useful new predictions, not new names. This targets duplicate-work farming rather than proving unique operators.
